messages:
Caleb H: Quick thread to align on rollout strategy for the regional A/B with fallback policy. Customer ops want deterministic cutover and clear rollback ladder.
Maya R: Key constraints: some SDKs only poll flags, client diversity (mobile/web/embedded), and enterprise Private installs with custom flag sync.
Toni Y: We should separate decision domains: model routing (server-side) vs presentation/UI (client-side). Only critical fallback decisions should be server-controlled.
Samir K: Agreed. For A/B test we can do server-side assignment + sticky cookie/session + optional client flag for UI tuning. That way rollback is immediate for model variants.
Caleb H: Proposal: three-layer rollout control: 1) Orchestration (server routing + model weights), 2) Fast-invalidate flags (hard flags + signed token poll), 3) Soft flags for UX.
Maya R: For the hard flags, SDKs must support token polling at configurable intervals (default 30s). Private installs can relax interval. Documented trade-offs.
Toni Y: Canary plan: Stage 0 shadow baseline. Stage 1 server-side 2% routing + no client flip. Stage 2 split cohorts with hard-flag-enabled clients at 5%. Stage 3 regional ramp. Hold 2h per stage.
Samir K: Add an A/B metric set: engagement delta, completion rate, p99 latency, model error-rate. Define primary metric and safety guardrails. For AB we also need bucketing stability across sessions.
Caleb H: Rollback ladder: (1) mark cohort as disabled in routing (server), (2) rotate signed token causing immediate client re-eval, (3) push hard flag to force UI off, (4) global kill. Each step logged and reversible.
Maya R: Telemetry: emit decision_source (server/flag/token), flag_version, last_refresh_ts, token_check_lag. Console should have an "inconsistent decisions" alert if same session sees mixed decision_source > 0.2% of requests.
Toni Y: For A/B significance gating: require 90% power at effect size threshold and no safety alerts for 24h before wider ramp. Ops can override only with documented exceptions.
Samir K: Action items: Caleb - draft playbook with three-layer control and rollback ladder (ETA 3d). Maya - telemetry schema + console alerts (ETA 4d). Toni - canary metric definitions and gating logic (ETA 3d). deploy-bot - stub token rotate API with HMAC signing and audit logging (ETA 48h).
deploy-bot: created ticket RFC-2026-ab-rollout-controls and will stub endpoint. Audit will include actor+2fa.
Caleb H: Also customer ask: enterprise Private wants opt-in to control bucketing seed. We'll document security and experiment validity implications.
Maya R: Good. We'll run a simulated AB in staging with synthetic stale clients and report back. Re-convene after PRs land. :white_check_mark:
